summary: Found one replay-integrity defect. Both existing episode test binaries passed all five tests; no tests were weakened. README scope and integration ownership are accurate. No files were changed or network used.

findings.finding: Concession still accepts an internal opening-to-turn boundary. After both seats submit Keep, progress is CoreProgress::OpeningComplete with no turn position; boundary() reports InternalYield, but this guard only rejects CoreProgress::InternalYield. Conceding immediately produces a Completed result before turns start. Advancing first and then conceding produces the identical semantic history but a different final turn state and generation. Existing played_replay also automatically starts turns after the last Keep, so it cannot reconstruct the former result. Reject concession at the OpeningComplete/no-turn boundary as well, and add a regression covering both Keep submissions followed immediately by concession.
